# SlideNotFoundException

<link-summary>A slide was expected and the value is not one, or the slide asked for does not exist in the presentation.</link-summary>

<web-summary>SlideNotFoundException — A slide was expected and the value is not one, or the slide asked for does not exist in the presentation. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>exception/appsscript/slide</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
class SlideNotFoundException extends RuntimeException
```

A slide was expected and the value is not one, or the slide asked for does not exist in the presentation.

Thrown by [`requireSlide`](requireSlide.md).

Every class in this hierarchy takes an optional message, another exception whose message it reuses, or nothing at all. `isException` recognises all of them; a plain `Error` is not one.

## Examples

### Throwing and catching

```javascript
throw new SlideNotFoundException("something specific about this call");

try {
  doWork();
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof SlideNotFoundException) {
    // handled
  }
}
```
